integrity: Complete mathematical statement, analytic proof, precise literature comparisons and a standalone exact-rational verifier are supplied.
scientific_limitations: Finite normalized edge-sampling processes with positive initial edge weights, at least one permanently receptive edge, fixed or eventually fixed classifications, and the specified positive reinforcement and multiplicative decrease. title: A universal logarithmic law for persistent incompatible contacts in adaptive bounded-confidence networks
